Beginner.title: Competent Crew
Beginner.desc:
A course to take the beginner to a safe and competent standard crewing a yacht. For those starting yachting. Often taught alongside Dayskipper students with both levels of students aboard.

This is a popular way for a beginner to start. If you have completed Start Yachting then you can go on to do a subsequent 3-day course which will bring you up to the level of Competent Crew. The alternative way is to go straight into a Competent Crew course run over 5-days or alternatively as 3 weekends.
Beginner.notes: The price includes RYA course completion certificate. Course starts at 09:00 on the first day and finishes approximately 16.00 on the last day. Food is not included in the course cost. A share in the cost of any meals taken ashore and any mooring fees away from home base will be payable to the skipper.

Intermediate.title: RYA Day Skipper
Intermediate.desc:
Teaches the skills and techniques to skipper a sailing yacht safely on coastal and offshore passages by day and night.
Recommended pre-course experience: 15 days at sea, 300 miles, 8 night hours, 2 days as skipper.
Intermediate.notes: The price includes RYA course completion certificate. Course starts at 09:00 on the first day and finishes approximately 16.00 on the last day. Food is not included in the course cost. A share in the cost of any meals taken ashore and any mooring fees away from home base will be payable to the skipper.

Advanced.title: RYA Yachtmaster Costal Prep & Exam
Advanced.desc:
These are the final stages of training for leisure yachtsmen and are run as 5-day courses followed by a practical sailing examination.
Work-up to hone skills before taking the Yachtmaster (YM) Exam, which usually follows the course immediately.
For those about to take the exam, the Gold Standard of the RYA cruising qualification system.
Advanced.notes:
Course starts at 09:00 on the first day and finishes approximately 16.00 on the last day. Food is not included in the course cost. A share in the cost of any meals taken ashore and any mooring fees away from home base will be payable to the skipper.
There is an examination fee, Yachtmaster Offshore £241, Yachtmaster Coastal £208 is additionally payable to the RYA.
